nodes.long_description:
Join discord in [Discord.gg/4JahB7ym32]

⚔️ Become a Hero in a Multiplayer Sword-Fighting Adventure!

Slime & Sword is a multiplayer VR adventure where you fight endless waves of slimes, battle unique enemies, roll powerful swords, build your base, and explore a massive world with friends. 

Go beyond the ordinary RNG game: beat challenges, discover insanely rare weapons, unlock hidden areas, and become the ultimate slime-fighting hero!

Roll powerful swords, defeat endless waves of slimes, and explore a massive multiplayer world with your friends!

🍀 Get lucky and roll powerful swords!
🗡️ Fight unique slime enemies
🎲 RNG system with insane rare drops
⬆️ Upgrade and evolve your swords
🏠 Build and upgrade your own base
🌍 Unlock new worlds and hidden areas
🏆Show off your rarest swords and dominate the leaderboards
👥 Team up with friends for more rewards!

Start your adventure now in Slimes & Swords RNG!

nodes.change_log:
Version 0.1.8

What's New:

🍀 Luck Multiplier Added

A new Luck Multiplier has been added, giving all players a better chance to obtain rare swords.

🗡️ Free Discord Sword

Join our Discord community and claim an exclusive sword available only to Discord members.

📢 New Information Board

A new board has been added to the game where you can learn more about our games.

⚡ Improvements & Optimizations

Various gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and performance updates.

Version 0.1.7

What's New:

🌍 New Biome Added

A brand-new biome is now available to explore.

👾 New Enemies

New slime enemies have appeared. Get ready for tougher battles.

🗡️ New Swords

More swords have been added to the game. Time to test your luck again!

🍀 More Ways to Increase Luck

New opportunities to boost your Luck and unlock better swords 
faster.

🎮 Easier Start for New Players

The early game has been rebalanced to make progression smoother and more enjoyable.

🏠 Base Expansion Update

The size and layout of player bases have been adjusted for a better gameplay experience.

🔮 Next Update Preview

Coming soon:

- More Ways to Increase Luck

Version 0.1.6

What's New:

🌀 Fast Travel is Here
Teleport between your base and biomes in just one click.

🗡️ Sword Display System
Players now show their equipped sword above their heads.

🏆 New Leaderboards
Additional leaderboards have been added so you can compete with other players and track your progress.

⚡ Improvements & Optimizations
Various gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and performance updates.

🔮 Next Update Preview

Coming soon:

• New biomes to explore
• New swords to collect
• New enemies to defeat
• More content and improvements

Version 0.1.5

🌍 New Biome Added
A brand-new area is now available to explore.

👾 New Enemies
Discover and battle new slime enemies with unique behaviors.

🗡️ New Swords
More swords have been added to the game. Time to test your luck!

🖥️ Improved UI
The interface has been moved higher for better visibility and comfort.

⚔️ Better Sword Handling
Improved sword grab system for smoother gameplay.

⚡ One-Click Sword Selection
The sword selection system has been redesigned. Choosing your sword is now faster and easier.

🚀 Performance Improvements
Improved FPS and reduced freezes across the game for a smoother experience.

🔧 Various Bug Fixes and Improvements

🔮 Coming Soon

We're already working on the next update, which will include:

• Teleport system between your base and biomes
• A brand-new biome
• New enemies
• New swords
• More improvements and surprises

----

Have any ideas on how to improve the game? Let us know at info@dream-dev.com.

Thanks!
